composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 26-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Design an elegant adult woman with golden-brown eyes, a balanced oval face, expressive brows, and a relaxed smile. Her deep-emerald waves stay behind her shoulders, showing the face clearly. She wears an opaque cream cotton sleeveless top with a neat boat neckline and loose teal culottes reaching mid-calf, plus comfortable woven sandals. Walking slowly along a tropical timber boardwalk, she holds a fresh coconut drink with both hands at waist height, stopping briefly to look toward the viewer. Broad palm leaves frame only the side edges, while the background opens toward a pale turquoise lagoon. Use cream, sea green, coconut brown, and restrained lime accents. Filtered afternoon sunlight creates soft leaf shadows without obscuring her features. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.
